purpose: Define non-executing, append-only planning for retaining accepted AXIOM source states in provider-independent Git mirrors.
core_invariant: A mirror preserves accepted source evidence; it does not choose accepted source and it does not gain write authority from transport capability.
claim_boundary: This contract does not execute git clone, fetch, push, or ref updates.
This contract does not configure a real mirror.
This contract does not prove an independent geographic or provider failure domain.
This contract does not promote any repository or mirror capability.
A verified mirror plan remains explicitly non-executing until a future durable Grid-prepared effect authorizes the exact operation.
